newsitem.title: ITALY: AdR to invest 20 bln lire in Fiumicino upgrading.
newsitem.headline: AdR to invest 20 bln lire in Fiumicino upgrading.

text.p: Rome's airport authority (AdR) said it will spend 20 billion lire over the next three years on upgrading cargo information, luggage handling and sorting systems at Fiumicino.

The aim is "to improve current quality levels, and prepare for Fiumicino's Cargo City and bring customs procedures into line with those required by European Union regulations," AdR said in a recent statement.
Other cargo-related investment within the 20 billion lire includes export offices, creation of 150 ULD storage racks and 400 sq m of shelving, it added.
Improved security for warehouse access and cargo movement will also be provided to ensure that "cargo in Fiumicino is safe." --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
